thread:
alex: Quick FYI — I have three dependent PRs that need ordering before the Thursday merge window: SDK#452, API#330, console#788. SDK changes the client auth header, API exposes a new optional query param, console consumes both. Need approvals and a merge order. Can @maria review API? @sam can you sanity-check console import path? If we don't sequence, console CI will fail.

sam: taking a look, saw failing tests locally — console import path changed from rev1 to rev2. I'll paste failing trace:
```
ImportError: cannot import name 'AuthClient' from 'redwood.sdk.client'
```
I'll try a quick fix but need SDK to merge first.

maria: I can review API later today. Question: is the new query param backward-compatible? if so I can approve and we can merge API before console, but SDK must land first if it affects types.

jin: Heads up — helm chart changes in chart/runtime require bump of runtime image tag to v2.3.0-rc. SDK/artifacts won't be compatible if runtime stays at v2.2.x. Suggested sequence: SDK -> API -> chart/runtime#102 -> console. There's a migration script at runtime/migrate.sh that console needs to handle.

merge-bot: [auto] Added branches to merge queue. Order hint: SDK#452 -> API#330 -> chart/runtime#102 -> console#788. Estimated queue ETA ~45m.

alex: thanks. Plan: I'll rebase SDK and run the integration suite, will notify here when merged. If SDK merge delayed >1h we can consider a canary with a stubbed auth header in console to unblock staging only. Prefer to avoid that in prod. @maria please ping when API reviewed.

maria: ack, will finish review in ~2h. If I see anything blocking I'll request changes. :thumbsup: 

sam: re the import error — quick workaround in console to avoid failing CI while waiting for SDK:
```
try:
    from redwood.sdk.client import AuthClient
except ImportError:
    from redwood.sdk.legacy import AuthClient  # fallback
```
Not ideal but keeps CI green for staging runs. Will open a short-lived branch if we go that route.

alex: let's not land fallback in main. If needed push to a feature branch and tag it in the PR description. I'll post here when SDK is green and then we can sequence the rest.
